entities.name: Stefano Evodio Assemani
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Stefano Evodio Assemani, Ottoman-born orientalist, nephew of Giuseppe Simone Assemani and cousin of Giuseppe Luigi Assemani, was the chief assistant of his uncle Giuseppe Simone in his work in the Vatican Library.
